Priya (People Ops): quick check 52 Marta accepted offer remote-start on 2026-05-04 but her state ID renewal is pending. Can we still do Day-1 I-9?
Gabe (HR): yes if she can present an alternative acceptable doc combo. DL renewal pending is fine if she has unexpired SSN card + a temporary paper ID with photo. We need to record which docs in the file.
Marta (New Hire): I have a temporary receipt from DMV, SSN card, and a copy of my passport expiration page (scanned). I won't have the physical passport until next week.
Priya (People Ops): receipt + SSN card works for Section 2 verification if we do in-person or authorized rep. Since Marta is remote, we'll do a live video I-9 and capture timestamped screenshots. Also need her to upload scans to secure intake.
Marta (New Hire): I can do Zoom tomorrow 8am PT. I'll upload docs now.
IT Helpdesk: note for IT: do NOT provision admin groups until background cleared. Standard laptop + corp email ok.
BadgeBot: badge request created. Remote pickup not available. Onsite badge pickup requires original ID verification at office.
ClearTrace Bot: background check status: CONSENT_RECEIVED (1786123500). Vendor ETA: 48 hours. Possible fingerprint queue in some counties.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): can we still include Marta in orientation sessions Day 1 even if BG pending?
Gabe (HR): yes, orientation and benefits enrollment proceed. Access to payment systems and sensitive repos remain blocked until BG CLEAR. Mark hire as contingent in HRIS until vendor clears.
Priya (People Ops): steps: 1) Marta does Zoom I-9 with People Ops witness tomorrow 8am PT. 2) Marta uploads scans to secure intake. 3) People Ops attaches screenshots to BambooHR record. 4) IT will image laptop Day 1 and tag account "bg-pending".
Marta (New Hire): uploaded receipts and SSN card to the intake form. Zoom scheduled. Thanks!
Priya (People Ops): final note: capture the video witness log in the new-hire task and set reminder to collect original passport when it arrives (store in HR binder). We'll also set calendar reminder to follow up with ClearTrace in 72h if status != CLEARED.
ClearTrace Bot: background check update (1786123605): IN_REVIEW - county fingerprint backlog may delay final adjudication.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): thanks team, keep me posted.
Priya (People Ops): closing this thread once ClearTrace shows CLEARED. For now, action items recorded in Marta's onboarding checklist.
